title: Replace Commander with a Bun-native CLI parser
description: Replace Commander in src/cli/index.ts with a typed Bun.argv parser/dispatcher. Preserve init; task next/ready/list/audit/show/create/update/set-status/reopen/claim/release/finish; issue list/show/create/update/close; brief; validate; reindex; repair; report; sync; handoff create/show; prompt list/show/render; message post/list; inbox; git status; mcp; gh import/export; and dashboard. Preserve positional argument arity, every option in test/cli-help-options.test.ts, --root, --json, help/version output, CommandResult diagnostics, and exit status in source and compiled executable modes.
acceptance: All existing CLI command and option contracts are covered by source-mode and compiled-binary tests.
The native parser preserves global --root and --json behavior, help output, diagnostics, and nonzero exit codes.
Commander is removed from package.json and bun.lock only after the replacement passes release gates.
Bun 1.4 frozen install, tests, typecheck, Biome, build, and ledger validation pass.
notes: Execution inventory: src/cli/index.ts is the sole parser/adapter; test/cli-help-options.test.ts defines the help/option contract; test/lifecycle-parity.test.ts and test/skeleton.test.ts cover behavior. Add a parser-independent command specification and derive help/validation from it. Do not move mutation logic out of src/core. See docs/bun-native-stack-migration-plan.md.
